commit.message:
test: move 12 misplaced test files into the crates that own them

Eight heidenhain/probe/comment/lathe/doosan post tests go to
camcraft-post, boundary_walls and real_tip to camcraft-sim, arcs to
camcraft-motion, origin_approach to camcraft-cl. Imports switch from
camcraft_app/camcraft_motion to the owner crate, Gate maps name the
real crate, and the xtask pins follow the move (plus a new pin that
the files live in their owner crate). #[test] counts are unchanged.

Fixes #921

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CUsqDAgjpiZbXSvmXLvdmL
Merge remote-tracking branch 'upstream/main' into HEAD

fix(xtask): quick maps a #[path]-included file to its parent's submodule

crates/app/src/posting_index_swing.rs is app::posting::index_swing (posting.rs
includes it by #[path]), but quick read it as a top-level module no Gate map
names, so a change to the index-swing law selected none of its suites.
path_mods::included_as resolves the includer; pinned by
gate_maps_tests::a_path_included_file_selects_its_parents_submodule_suites.
PROCESS_VERSION 20 (xtask is a process file).

Fixes #1021

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CUsqDAgjpiZbXSvmXLvdmL

fix(xtask): map a #[path] file to both its own name and its parent's submodule (#1033 review)

A union, so resolving the includer only ever adds suites: posting_sim keeps
wall_column_gouge and contour_arc_sim, posting_suppressed keeps
rest_across_setups, posting_plasma keeps plasma_gate (pinned), and *_tests.rs
includes no longer narrow. #[path] in // comments is ignored.
